methods.what: Recursive relation for an auxiliary derivative function N' of the AGM under the AGM step (a,b)->(a',b')
Expansion of the recursion into an infinite series in the AGM differences
Identity for AGM iterates relating successive differences
Total differential of the AGM as series in squared-difference terms a^{(n)2}-b^{(n)2}
Numerical AGM iteration of 2 and 1 (arithmetic and geometric means converging to about 1.4567)
